cases.name: knowledge-reminder fixture: a repo with a knowledge base
cases.cmd:
K={{KIT}}/scripts; B={{FIX}}/kr-base; rm -rf $B; mkdir -p $B/.claude && cd $B && git init -q && git config user.name eval && git config user.email eval@example.invalid && git config commit.gpgsign false
mkdir -p src/Shop.Application/Catalog/Products/ArchiveProduct src/Shop.Application/Catalog/Products/GetProduct src/Shop.Application/Studio/Diagrams/AddNode src/Shop.Domain/Catalog/Aggregates tests/Shop.UnitTests/Catalog
printf 'using System;
namespace Shop;
public sealed class ArchiveProductCommandHandler
{
    // load then archive
    public void Handle() { var p = new Product(); p.Archive(); }
}
' > src/Shop.Application/Catalog/Products/ArchiveProduct/ArchiveProductCommandHandler.cs
printf '# ArchiveProductCommandHandler

## Business rules <!-- kit:rules -->

| ID | Rule | Outcome |
|----|------|---------|
| RM-01 | Only a published product can be archived | `ProductNotPublishedException` |
| RM-02 | Partitioned to the organisation | `ProductNotFoundException` |
' > src/Shop.Application/Catalog/Products/ArchiveProduct/CLAUDE.md
printf 'public sealed class GetProductQueryHandler
{
    public void Handle() { }
}
' > src/Shop.Application/Catalog/Products/GetProduct/GetProductQueryHandler.cs
printf 'public sealed class AddNodeCommandHandler
{
    public void Handle() { }
}
' > src/Shop.Application/Studio/Diagrams/AddNode/AddNodeCommandHandler.cs
printf 'public class Product
{
    public void Archive() { if (false) throw new ProductNotPublishedException(); }
}
public class ProductNotPublishedException : Exception {}
public record ProductArchivedEvent;
' > src/Shop.Domain/Catalog/Aggregates/Product.cs
printf '# Catalog design

## Archiving

Soft archive.

## Listing
' > src/Shop.Domain/Catalog/DESIGN.md
printf 'public class ArchiveProductCommandHandlerTests
{
    [Fact]
    [Trait("RM", "ArchiveProduct/RM-01")]
    public void Refuses_a_draft() { }

    [Fact]
    public void Archives() { }
}
' > tests/Shop.UnitTests/Catalog/ArchiveProductCommandHandlerTests.cs
printf '{"product": "Shop", "knowledge": {"contexts": {"Catalog": "CAT"}}}' > .claude/kit.config.json
git add -A && git commit -qm "feat(catalog): archive a product"
export CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR=$B
printf '{"product": "Shop", "knowledge": {"contexts": {"Catalog": "CAT", "Studio": "STU"}}}' > .claude/kit.config.json
ST=$(python3 $K/knowledge-write.py init); mkdir -p $ST/Catalog/usecases $ST/Studio/usecases
printf '# CAT-CU-?1 — Archive a product

Withdraw.

## Rules

### CAT-RM-?1 — Only a published product can be archived
Outcome: `ProductNotPublishedException`

## Handlers <!-- kit:handlers -->

- `ArchiveProductCommandHandler`: load, archive, save.
' > "$ST/Catalog/usecases/CAT-CU-?1-archive-product.md"
printf '# CAT-CU-?2 — Consult products

## Handlers <!-- kit:handlers -->

- `GetProductQueryHandler`: load.
' > "$ST/Catalog/usecases/CAT-CU-?2-consult-products.md"
printf '# STU-CU-?1 — Add a node

## Handlers <!-- kit:handlers -->

- `AddNodeCommandHandler`: add.
' > "$ST/Studio/usecases/STU-CU-?1-add-node.md"
python3 $K/knowledge-write.py apply >/dev/null && git add -A && git commit -qm "docs: knowledge base"
echo ok
